## `text_check`

**Title:** App-Kit text check  
**Annotations:** `readOnlyHint=true`, `destructiveHint=false`, `idempotentHint=false`, `openWorldHint=false`

```text
Check a text: metrics (filler words, spam, keyword stuffing), readability, stop phrases, grammar.

Input: text up to 20000 characters, lang (language of the text) ru or en. Returns passed (blocking thresholds),
metrics by layer, verdicts (blocking=false means a recommendation), top_issues (up to 5 main issues)
and locations: issue positions (offset/length) in the submitted text. The text is not stored.
Rate-limited per day; call quota_status for remaining calls.
```

### Input

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | `string` | yes | Text to check, up to 20000 characters |
| `lang` | `ru` / `en` | no | Language of the checked text |
| `layers` | array of `metrics` / `readability` / `phrases` / `grammar` | no | Layers: metrics, readability, phrases, grammar (all by default) |
| `response_lang` | `en` / `ru` | no | Language for human-readable messages; pass the user's language |

<details><summary>Input JSON Schema</summary>

```json

      "title": "Layers"
    },
    "response_lang": {
      "default": "en",
      "description": "Language for human-readable messages; pass the user's language",
      "enum": [
        "en",
        "ru"
      ],
      "title": "Response Lang",
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "text"
  ],
  "title": "text_checkArguments"
}
```

## `seo_audit_fast`

**Title:** App-Kit quick SEO audit  
**Annotations:** `readOnlyHint=true`, `destructiveHint=false`, `idempotentHint=false`, `openWorldHint=true`

```text
Quick SEO audit of a public website (up to 10 pages): score 0-100 by check group, failed checks, top 5 losses.

The site root is audited: URL path and query are dropped (https://example.com/page?x=1 -> https://example.com/).
Waits up to 60 s for the result, sending progress. If not done by then, returns
status=running and a handle: call seo_audit_status(handle) every poll_after_s seconds while status=running.
Rate-limited per day; call quota_status for remaining calls. One domain: up to 5 audits per day.
```

### Input

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `url` | `string` | yes | Public website URL, e.g. https://example.com (the site root is audited) |
| `lang` | `en` / `ru` | no | Language for human-readable messages; pass the user's language |

<details><summary>Input JSON Schema</summary>

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "url": {
      "description": "Public website URL, e.g. https://example.com (the site root is audited)",
      "title": "Url",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "lang": {
      "default": "en",
      "description": "Language for human-readable messages; pass the user's language",
      "enum": [
        "en",

      ],
      "title": "Lang",
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": [

}
```

## `seo_audit_status`

**Title:** App-Kit SEO audit status  
**Annotations:** `readOnlyHint=true`, `destructiveHint=false`, `idempotentHint=true`, `openWorldHint=true`

```text
Status and result of an SEO audit by the handle from seo_audit_fast / seo_audit_full_start. Does not consume quota.

While status=running, call again after poll_after_s seconds. A handle is valid for
60 min and only for the caller who started the audit.
```

### Input

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `handle` | `string` | yes | handle from seo_audit_fast / seo_audit_full_start |
| `lang` | `en` / `ru` | no | Language for human-readable messages; pass the user's language |

## `pdf_to_images`

**Title:** App-Kit PDF to images  
**Annotations:** `readOnlyHint=true`, `destructiveHint=false`, `idempotentHint=false`, `openWorldHint=true`

```text
Convert an existing PDF to images (one file per page): format png/jpeg/webp, dpi 72-300,
first_page/last_page. PDF up to 20 MB and up to 20 pages.
Input: exactly one of source_url (public URL, the server downloads it), upload_id (create_upload, then PUT) or data_base64 (up to 512 KB).
Output: download links (resource_link, valid for 10 min; deleted once all files of the job are downloaded) and a preview of the first image. If not done within 60 s, returns status=running and a handle: call conversion_status(handle).
Rate-limited per day; call quota_status for remaining calls.
```

### Input

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `source_url` | `string` | no | Public file URL (the server downloads it); preferred for hosted clients |
| `upload_id` | `string` | no | upload_id from create_upload (after the file PUT) |
| `data_base64` | `string` | no | File as base64, only for small files (up to 512 KB) |
| `format` | `png` / `jpeg` / `webp` | no | Page image format |
| `dpi` | `integer` | no | Resolution 72-300 dpi |
| `first_page` | `integer` | no | First page (from 1) |
| `last_page` | `integer` | no | Last page |
| `lang` | `en` / `ru` | no | Language for human-readable messages; pass the user's language |

## `image_convert`

**Title:** App-Kit image conversion  
**Annotations:** `readOnlyHint=true`, `destructiveHint=false`, `idempotentHint=false`, `openWorldHint=true`

```text
Convert an existing image to another format: target_format png/jpeg/webp/bmp/tiff/gif, quality 1-100,
max_dim (downscale the long side). File up to 20 MB. For avif and maximum compression use image_compress.
Input: exactly one of source_url (public URL, the server downloads it), upload_id (create_upload, then PUT) or data_base64 (up to 512 KB).
Output: download links (resource_link, valid for 10 min; deleted once all files of the job are downloaded) and a preview of the first image. If not done within 60 s, returns status=running and a handle: call conversion_status(handle).
Rate-limited per day; call quota_status for remaining calls.
```

### Input

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `target_format` | `png` / `jpeg` / `webp` / `bmp` / `tiff` / `gif` | yes | Target format |
| `source_url` | `string` | no | Public file URL (the server downloads it); preferred for hosted clients |
| `upload_id` | `string` | no | upload_id from create_upload (after the file PUT) |
| `data_base64` | `string` | no | File as base64, only for small files (up to 512 KB) |
| `quality` | `integer` | no | Quality 1-100 (jpeg/webp) |
| `max_dim` | `integer` | no | Downscale the long side to N px |
| `lang` | `en` / `ru` | no | Language for human-readable messages; pass the user's language |

## `conversion_status`

**Title:** App-Kit conversion status  
**Annotations:** `readOnlyHint=true`, `destructiveHint=false`, `idempotentHint=true`, `openWorldHint=false`

```text
Status and result of a conversion by the handle from pdf_to_images / images_to_pdf / image_convert.
Does not consume quota. While status=running, call again after poll_after_s seconds.
A handle is valid for 1 hour and only for the caller who started the conversion.
```

### Input

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `handle` | `string` | yes | handle from pdf_to_images / images_to_pdf / image_convert |
| `lang` | `en` / `ru` | no | Language for human-readable messages; pass the user's language |

      "enum": [
        "en",
        "ru"
      ],
      "title": "Lang",
      "type": "string"

  "required": [

  "title": "conversion_statusArguments"

## `create_upload`

**Title:** App-Kit file upload  
**Annotations:** `readOnlyHint=false`, `destructiveHint=false`, `idempotentHint=false`, `openWorldHint=false`

```text
Create a one-time upload link for a local file (for clients with local file access, e.g. Claude Code, Cursor).

Returns upload_id, put_url and a curl command: upload the file with a single PUT (up to
20 MB, within 10 min), then pass upload_id
to a file tool. One upload_id serves one call. For a file at a public URL, pass source_url directly instead.
Rate-limited per day; call quota_status for remaining calls.
```

### Input

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `filename` | `string` | yes | File name, e.g. report.pdf |
| `size` | `integer` | yes | File size in bytes |
| `content_type` | `string` | no | MIME type, e.g. application/pdf or image/png |
| `lang` | `en` / `ru` | no | Language for human-readable messages; pass the user's language |

<details><summary>Input JSON Schema</summary>

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "filename": {
      "description": "File name, e.g. report.pdf",
      "maxLength": 200,
      "title": "Filename",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "size": {
      "description": "File size in bytes",
      "exclusiveMinimum": 0,
      "title": "Size",
      "type": "integer"
    },
    "content_type": {
      "default": "application/octet-stream",
      "description": "MIME type, e.g. application/pdf or image/png",
      "title": "Content Type",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "lang": {
      "default": "en",
      "description": "Language for human-readable messages; pass the user's language",
      "enum": [
        "en",
        "ru"
      ],
      "title": "Lang",
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "filename",
    "size"
  ],
  "title": "create_uploadArguments"
}
```

## Planned tools (not in `tools/list` yet)

Rolling out next. Arguments and output below are the design contract; the exact JSON Schemas
will appear in this file once the tools are live (the file is regenerated from `tools/list`).

### `image_compress`

Compress and resize an image into WebP or AVIF.

- **Input:** one of `source_url` (public URL), `upload_id` (from `create_upload`) or `data_base64` (up to 512 KB); `format` webp/avif, `quality`, `width`, `height`, `preset`, `lossless`.
- **Output:** `resource_link` to the result (signed, 10 min), `original_size`, `converted_size`, `compression_ratio`, `width`, `height`, `quota`.
- **Limits:** Rate-limited per day; see https://app-kit.dev/mcp.
